why_trace.root_cause: A live enforce-mode agent run showed the Stop hook reading the transcript before the final reply was flushed, and quote checks attributing one claim's code span to neighbouring citations.
evidence: Live headless run: first Stop check saw 0 citations, the second saw 22; settled re-read added
Same run: 10 quote_mismatch false flags fell to 0 after nearest-citation attribution and expression-only quote checks (24/24 verified)
Benchmark 3 iteration 6: 100% detection, 0.43% false-flag rate on injected citations
